coin.title: 50 years Van Gogh Museum Silver 5 ounce
coin.description: With over 1.5 million visitors every year, the Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam is one of the most popular museums in The Netherlands. The museum has the world’s biggest collection of works by Vincent van Gogh. For 50 years, the Van Gogh Museum inspires people with the work and life story of Vincent van Gogh. Especially for this jubilee, the Royal Dutch Mint launches a unique issue with handwork from our silversmiths: the 50 years Van Gogh Museum Silver 5 ounce. 50 years of access to Van Goghs masterpieces After the passing of Vincent van Gogh, his works are managed by his brother Theo and his wife, Johanna van Gogh-Bonger. Their son and Vincent’s nephew, Vincent Willem, starts the Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962. He comes to an agreement with the Dutch State to build the Van Gogh Museum, where the family collection can be managed and preserved for future generations. The Van Gogh Museum is opened on June 2th 1973 by Queen Juliana. In 50 years, the museum has had over 53 million visitors. The museum organizes many exhibitions, with subjects that show and deepen the work and life of Vincent van Gogh and his time. Bring a handmade masterpiece into your home To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Van Gogh Museum, a limited edition of a special issue is available: the 50 years Van Gogh Museum Silver 5 ounce. This issue is inspired by Sunflowers (1889) the masterpiece by Vincent van Gogh that can be admired in the permanent collection of the museum. One of the sunflowers is enamelled by hand on the coin, done by our own silversmiths. This creates a special color effect. This way, the colors in the painting also come alive on the coin. The obverse of the coin contains the logo for 50 years Van Gogh Museum. The 50 years Van Gogh Museum Silver 5 ounce is delivered in a special packaging, which is also based on Sunflowers (1889). This way, you will have your own masterpiece at home. With a limited mintage of only 50 pieces, this issue is bound to sell out fast!
